title: Propagate #creationId update keys / destroy ids (resolve_set_id_refs) to sibling servers
description: Mirror JMAP-tna1.14 (canonical in jmap-mail-server; see its AGENTS.md '#creationId' section) in every sibling *-server /set handler: chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, scene, vtc, graph, chat-filenode, chat-mimi, metadata as applicable. Call jmap_server::resolve_set_id_refs(&mut args, created_ids, &Map::new()) at handler entry and again with the call's created map after the create phase. Handlers without created_ids get a crate-private variant (public signature unchanged). Acceptance per crate: dispatcher test where call 1 creates and call 2 updates and destroys via #cid (and one same-call case), results keyed by real id; unknown #ref keeps today's error. Not /get ids (see tna1.14 decision).
